method: Guarded BEGIN READ ONLY; information_schema, PostgreSQL catalogs and Prisma migration metadata only; no business-row reads or mutations

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ledger_posting_batches_organizationId_idempotencyKey_key" ON public.ledger_posting_batches USING btree ("organizationId", "idempotencyKey")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "ledger_posting_batches_organizationId_sourceType_sourceId_p_key" ON public.ledger_posting_batches USING btree ("organizationId", "sourceType", "sourceId", "postingPurpose")
CREATE INDEX "ledger_posting_batches_organizationId_status_createdAt_idx" ON public.ledger_posting_batches USING btree ("organizationId", status, "createdAt")
CREATE INDEX "ledger_posting_batches_periodId_idx" ON public.ledger_posting_batches USING btree ("periodId")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_posting_batches_pkey ON public.ledger_posting_batches USING btree (id)

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("organizationId") REFERENCES organizations(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY ("periodId") REFERENCES accounting_periods(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL

queries.migrationTables: SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = '_prisma_migrations' ORDER BY table_schema
queries.history: SELECT id, migration_name, checksum, started_at, finished_at, rolled_back_at, applied_steps_count FROM public._prisma_migrations WHERE migration_name = $1 ORDER BY started_at
queries.historySummary: SELECT count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL)::int AS finished, count(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at IS NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL)::int AS unfinished, max(finished_at) AS latest_finished_at FROM public._prisma_migrations
queries.columns: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'ledger_posting_batches' ORDER BY ordinal_position
queries.indexes: SELECT ci.relname AS index_name, i.indisunique AS is_unique, i.indisvalid AS is_valid, i.indisready AS is_ready, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) AS definition FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ct ON ct.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = ct.relnamespace JOIN pg_class ci ON ci.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND ct.relname = 'ledger_posting_batches' ORDER BY ci.relname
queries.constraints: SELECT c.conname AS constraint_name, c.contype AS type, c.convalidated AS validated, c.condeferrable AS deferrable, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid, true) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND t.relname = 'ledger_posting_batches' ORDER BY c.conname
